_comment: Feature flags for the 2026-04-19 sprint. Every key defaults to false in backend/feature_flags.py. Flip a value to true here to enable the feature in the running deployment. Unknown keys are ignored with a console warning.
_comment_onboarding: Onboarding redesign (docs/plans/onboarding-conversion/plan.md v2.1). onboarding.v2 is the master kill-switch: a feature is live iff onboarding.v2 AND its own flag. All ship dark. analytics.client_events sits OUTSIDE the master — it starts the pre-redesign baseline capture and should be flipped true first. LAUNCH PAIRING: flip landing.try_before_sync together with onboarding.landing — the backend demo endpoint (/api/session/demo) 404s without it and the landing's Sleeper-down escape + demo link depend on it.
_comment_monetization: Monetization platform (docs/plans/monetization/00-platform-foundation.md). One flag per strategy, ALL dark until operator green-light. Rollout order: monetize.entitlements first (observe mode - logs, never blocks), then monetize.founder + monetize.paywall for the TestFlight window, monetize.pro + monetize.season_pass at launch, growth.* after, ads last. Rankings marketplace flags (ranks.*, marketplace.*) follow their plan's season-aligned phases.
_comment_teardown: 2026-07-19 app-teardown remediation (branch teardown-remediation; PRDs in gitignored app-teardown-review/). ALL dark until operator review. Exceptions shipped unflagged by design: the league-prefs authz fix (security), doc/legal-copy corrections, and inert accessibility annotations (labels/roles/traits). Flag-per-behavior below; rollout notes live in each PRD.
_comment_testing: QA/testing surfaces. testing.stage_users gates the synthetic stage-user spawner (POST/DELETE /api/test-users, backend/test_users.py) used to QA the onboarding flow with qa_* users at preset adoption stages. Requests must ALSO come from a tester-allowlist device/user (config/tester_allowlist.json or FTF_TESTER_ALLOWLIST), so flipping this on never exposes the surface to real users. Default false; flip only during onboarding QA windows.
_comment_tiktok_discovery: 2026-07-26 TikTok-discovery deck engine (docs/plans/tiktok-discovery/). Flags flipped ON per-wave at each TestFlight ship. deck.value_model stays dark until an F8 replay win (PRD F6 gate). F8 eval harness is unflagged operator tooling.
_comment_rookie_draft: 2026-08-06 Rookie rankings + Draft Room (docs/plans/rookie-draft/). All flags land OFF and flip at each milestone's release gate. ranks.rookie_subset gates the scope=rookie view filter on /api/rankings + /api/trio and the merged-band scoped tier save; off = the scope param is never read. draft.room gates GET /api/draft/board and the mobile Draft Room (off = the League tab keeps today's rookie-board tile). draft.live_poll gates the 15s client poll of our own endpoint (focus + foreground + state:live only); it stays off until the throwaway-league live test passes. draft.mfl gates the MFL binding inside GET /api/draft/board (off = an MFL league keeps today's honest platform_unsupported payload and zero MFL reads); MFL live mode stays behind draft.live_poll until the timed mid-draft latency probe passes. picks.slot_values gates the display-only per-slot pick prices on the Draft Room board (DynastyProcess values.csv PICK rows, hermetic seam FTF_DP_PICK_VALUES_FILE); off = the slot_value key is omitted entirely and values.csv is never fetched. trade.slot_pricing gates the M6b engine repricing (operator decision O2, which reverses hld KD-9/lld §4.7): the per-user pick_pricing_mode setting (tier_ladder default | market_slots) and GET/PUT /api/settings/pick-pricing; off = every user prices owned picks at the stored ladder pool_value, the route 404s, and GENERIC_PICK_SEEDS/tier bands are byte-unchanged (they are unchanged in BOTH modes).
_comment_draft_extensions: 2026-08-06 Draft-surface extensions W1 (docs/plans/draft-extensions/). draft.rank_inline gates the Draft Room's per-player row ACTIONS: long-press + an accessibilityActions custom action (the shipped TradeCard vocabulary — there is no visible overflow glyph in this app) opens the shared PlayerContextMenu with Set my value (an anchor sheet on the SHIPPED POST /api/anchor/save lane, carrying via:draft_room), Rank the rookies (the existing bridge, now two-way) and Add to targets, plus the coverage nudge. Anchor lane ONLY — nothing this flag opens may reach save_tiers_position or the merged-band path (AST + runtime tests in backend/tests/test_draft_extensions_w1.py). Off = undrafted rows are the inert Views they are today; the per-player testIDs ship unflagged because they are inert and are what makes the flag testable.
